svg.title: y = e^x and y = ln x
svg.desc: The crimson curve y = e to the x passes through (0, 1) and (1, e), stays above the x-axis and rises steeply to the right. The blue curve y = ln x passes through (1, 0) and (e, 1), exists only for x greater than 0, and drops steeply near the y-axis. The two curves are mirror images across the dashed line y = x: each point (a, b) on one matches (b, a) on the other.
